doc:
### PROPOSAL-06 — Terminal / Green Phosphor - **slug**: `terminal` - **Vibe**: You are in the machine — a CRT terminal where every pixel is phosphor green and every word is honest log output. - **Best for**: Playwright automation cockpit, posting logs, and the agency publishing feed — the "fit for purpose" theme for a product built on browser automation. Adjectives: precise, no-nonsense, authentic. - **Palette** (dark theme, `is_dark: true`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#050d07` | Near-black CRT phosphor canvas | | `--bg-surface` | `#0a1a10` | Terminal panel fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#0f2417` | Raised panels, log focus rows | | `--border-subtle` | `#14331f` | Faint grid lines | | `--border-default` | `#1f4d2e` | Standard borders | | `--border-focus` | `#5cff9e` | Bright phosphor focus outline | | `--text-primary` | `#b4ffc8` | Bright green headings and output | | `--text-secondary` | `#74d99a` | Body/log text | | `--text-muted` | `#3f8f60` | Dimmed log lines, timestamps | | `--color-action` | `#46ff9c` | Phosphor-green primary action | | `--color-action-hover` | `#2ce084` | Action hover (deeper green) | | `--color-earnings` | `#ffd166` | Amber-phosphor earnings line | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#f2b93d` | Earnings hover (deeper amber) | | `--color-automation` | `#6cd6ff` | Cyan-phosphor automation accents | | `--color-alert` | `#ffb000` | Amber warnings | | `--color-danger` | `#ff6b6b` | Red-phosphor failed states | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(70, 255, 156, 0.18)` | Green glow behind active markers | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(255, 209, 102, 0.14)` | Amber glow behind earnings markers | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(108, 214, 255, 0.14)` | Cyan glow behind automation markers | - **Typography**: Mono everything. Display: `"VT323", "IBM Plex Mono", monospace` used only for very large numerals/headings (it is pixelated at small sizes). Sans and body: `"IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` at 400-600. Labels uppercase at `letter-spacing: 0.08em`. All numbers `tabular-nums`. - **Radii & Borders**: Square — `border-radius: 0` everywhere, except 2px on buttons. Borders are 1px. No shadows, no glows beyond token glows; the CRT effect comes from scanlines, not depth. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Square, 1px border, uppercase mono label. Primary = bright green fill with black text; hover inverts (dark fill, bright green text). Secondary = transparent with 1px border; focus = 1px bright border, no ring. - **Cards**: Square with a 1px border and a title bar that reads `[task_id]` or `~/affiliatemanager`; subtle scanline overlay inside. No elevation — flat CRT. - **Badges/Status**: Bracket chips: `[PUBLISHED]`, `[FAILED]`, `[RUNNING]` in phosphor colors; publishing = blinking block cursor after the label. Failed = red text on black, never a filled banner. - **Tables**: Monospace cells, single 1px grid, header rows prefixed with `>`. Rows are log lines; hover = bright green text. - **Forms/Inputs**: Single-line fields with a block underscore cursor; labels prefixed with `$` or `>`. Focus = bright green border. - **Loading**: Indeterminate = blinking block cursor on a `$` prompt; determinate = a `[====> ]` bar built from ASCII-ish segments. No spinners. - **Signature detail**: The scanline overlay (repeating-linear-gradient at ~3px) plus the blinking block cursor and `$`/`>` prompts — unmistakably a terminal. - **Motion & Animation**: Instant and mechanical: new log lines "type" in (per-character 0-30ms, per-line 150ms fade), status toggles flicker once. No springs, no parallax. Everything snaps to a mono grid. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
[09:42:11] PUBLISHED tiktok-8821.mp4 -> live · views 120
```
